test_cases.scenario_ref: Stock increase with reason is recorded

expected_assertions.description: P1 stock_available transitions from 5 to 15 after +10 adjustment with reason='restocked_from_supplier'.

Audit event 'inventory.adjusted' enumerates all 7 fields: event='inventory.adjusted', actor='admin:aoy', ts (ISO-8601), before={stock_available:5}, after={stock_available:15}, reason='restocked_from_supplier', idem_key (non-empty). (AP-Q12)

test_cases.scenario_ref: Adjustment without reason is rejected

expected_assertions.description: Request rejected with field-level error code 'reason_required'.
P1 stock_available is unchanged after rejected adjustment.
No 'inventory.adjusted' audit event is emitted for a rejected adjustment.

test_cases.scenario_ref: Cannot reduce stock below currently-reserved

expected_assertions.description: Adjustment rejected with reason='would_break_reservations' when invariant violated.
stock_available + stock_reserved >= existing reservations remains true.

test_cases.scenario_ref: Stock can never become negative under any path

expected_assertions.description: Adjustment rejected with reason='stock_cannot_go_negative'.
P1 stock_available stays at 1 after rejected -5 adjustment.

test_cases.scenario_ref: Banking-grade audit assertion: 7-field audit row on inventory adjust

expected_assertions.description: Field 'event' equals 'inventory.adjusted' (AP-Q12 field 1).
Field 'actor' equals 'admin:aoy' (AP-Q12 field 2).
Field 'ts' is ISO-8601 timestamp (AP-Q12 field 3).
Field 'before' captures pre-state snapshot (AP-Q12 field 4).
Field 'after' captures post-state snapshot (AP-Q12 field 5).
Field 'reason' is non-empty mandatory string (AP-Q12 field 6).
Field 'idem_key' present and non-empty (AP-Q12 field 7).

test_cases.scenario_ref: Banking-grade authz on admin-only inventory-adjust endpoint

expected_assertions.description: Non-admin caller receives HTTP 403 (or 404) on POST /admin/inventory/adjust.
authz_denied audit event emitted with 7 standard fields (event='authz_denied', actor, ts, before={authz_state}, after={authz_state}, reason='not_admin', idem_key).

test_cases.scenario_ref: Idempotency: double-click inventory adjust does not double-apply

expected_assertions.description: Repeated POST with same idem_key produces stock delta of +10 once, not twice.
Exactly one 'inventory.adjusted' audit event with that idem_key exists.

test_cases.scenario_ref: Customer writes a review for a delivered order line

expected_assertions.description: A review row is created tied to {customer:C1, order:O1, line:P1, rating:5, text:'<delivery_speed_remark_th>', is_hidden:false}.
P1.average_rating and P1.review_count refresh to reflect the new review.
Audit event 'review.created' emitted with all 7 fields (event, actor='customer:c1', ts, before=null, after={review_row_id}, reason='customer_initiated', idem_key). (AP-Q12)

test_cases.scenario_ref: Second review on same order line is rejected

expected_assertions.description: Second submit rejected with reason='already_reviewed'.
Review-row count for {O1,P1} remains 1.

test_cases.scenario_ref: Review rejected for non-delivered order

expected_assertions.description: Request rejected with reason='order_not_delivered'.
No review row created.

test_cases.scenario_ref: Rating outside 1-5 is rejected

expected_assertions.description: Rating 0 and rating 6 each rejected with reason='rating_out_of_range'.
Rating 1 and rating 5 each accepted (inclusive bounds).

test_cases.scenario_ref: Admin soft-hides a review with reason and review is not edited

expected_assertions.description: R1.is_hidden becomes true; R1.text unchanged (admin cannot edit).
Hidden review does not appear on the public PDP.
Audit event 'review.hidden' emitted with all 7 fields (event, actor='admin:aoy', ts, before={is_hidden:false}, after={is_hidden:true}, reason='violates_review_policy', idem_key). (AP-Q12)

test_cases.scenario_ref: Banking-grade authz: only admins can hide reviews; only owning customer can submit

expected_assertions.description: Non-admin attempting to hide a review receives HTTP 403.
Customer attempting to submit a review for an order they do not own receives HTTP 403.
authz_denied audit event emitted with all 7 standard fields.

test_cases.scenario_ref: Banking-grade tipping-off: moderation rejection copy does not disclose detection rule

expected_assertions.description: Customer-visible moderation-rejection copy contains no detection-rule name, internal code, or threshold value (AP-Q11 applied to product copy).
Copy uses generic language only (e.g. 'This review violates our community guidelines') and does not disclose which rule fired.
Internal moderation audit event records the specific rule_id, while the customer-facing notification message contains no rule_id.

test_cases.scenario_ref: Notification log: review-status change to customer is logged with notification_logged=true

expected_assertions.description: Every customer-facing review-status notification emits a notification-log row with notification_logged=true and references the notification template id.
Notification-log payload contains customer_id (indirect) only, not email/phone/name in plaintext (masking_rule applied per pii_inventory).

test_cases.scenario_ref: Idempotency: duplicate review-submit with same idem_key produces single row

expected_assertions.description: Replayed POST with same idem_key results in exactly one review row.
Exactly one 'review.created' audit event with that idem_key.

test_cases.scenario_ref: Admin views audit row with before/after diff

expected_assertions.description: Audit row renders with actor, action='product.price_changed', entity_id, ts, before={price:1290}, after={price:999}, reason.

test_cases.scenario_ref: Audit-log payload never contains forbidden fields (banking-grade audit)

expected_assertions.description: No row in the audit corpus contains a regex match for 'password', 'password_hash', 'token', 'card_number', or PAN-shaped digit sequences in any payload field.
If any forbidden match is detected by the self-test scrubber, the export fails closed and an alert is raised.
Every sampled audit row enumerates all 7 fields (event, actor, ts, before, after, reason, idem_key) (AP-Q12).

test_cases.scenario_ref: Customer cannot reach audit-log endpoint (authz)

expected_assertions.description: GET /admin/audit by non-admin returns HTTP 403 or 404.
authz_denied audit event emitted with all 7 standard fields.

test_cases.scenario_ref: Cross-cutting: every state-changing event across all epics emits an audit event with 7 fields

expected_assertions.description: For each enumerated state-changing event class (catalog.*, order.*, inventory.adjusted, review.created, review.hidden, identity.*, payment.*, fulfillment.*), at least one audit row is emitted per occurrence.
Every sampled audit row enumerates all 7 fields (event, actor, ts, before, after, reason, idem_key) (AP-Q12).

test_cases.scenario_ref: Cross-cutting: every customer-facing notification logged with notification_logged=true

expected_assertions.description: For each customer-facing notification class (order updates, signup confirm, password reset, review-status), a notification-log row is recorded with notification_logged=true.
Notification-log payload masks PII per pii_inventory[*].masking_rule — email partial-masked, phone partial-masked outside fulfilment context, password/token never appear.

test_cases.scenario_ref: Cross-cutting: PII redaction across log volume per pii_inventory masking rules

expected_assertions.description: Synthetic fixtures (AP-Q7: no real PII) carry well-known marker tokens; log scan must detect zero plaintext markers for password and session_token (always-masked rule), and the configured partial-mask pattern for phone outside fulfilment surfaces.
shipping_address line is scrubbed from authz_denied audit payloads per pii_inventory.shipping_address.masking_rule.

compliance_tests.scope: Verify audit-log retention enforces the Computer Crime Act 90-day minimum retention window (rows >= 90 days old retained; deletion before 90d blocked). Retention threshold sourced from CCA-TH-LOG-90D citation, not invented (AP-Q9).
Verify audit-log rows carry tamper-evident hashing (e.g. hash-chained per row) and any in-place modification is detectable. Append-only invariant per OQ-20.
Verify every read of the audit-log surface itself is audit-emitted (access audit per 6.6). Reader identity and queried filter captured.

Verify procedure for lawful-access requests (law-enforcement / regulator). Audit-log export workflow exists, is admin-gated, is itself audit-emitted, and uses the scrubbing path that fails-closed on forbidden-field detection.

Verify PII-redaction rule applied to all log surfaces per pii_inventory[*].masking_rule. Sample-based scan across audit log and notification log; zero leaks for always-masked fields (password, session_token); partial-mask pattern verified for phone/email in non-fulfilment surfaces; address scrubbed from authz_denied payloads.

Verify cross-border-transfer controls when mock-shipping or mock-payment endpoints route through non-Thailand regions. Residency-rule per pii_inventory enforced; transfer events audit-emitted with destination region recorded.

Verify each processing activity (signup, order, review-submit, audit-read, notification-send, review-moderation) is annotated with a lawful basis (consent / contract / legitimate-interest / legal-obligation) and that the record-of-processing-activities export contains all activities.

test_data_specs.synthesis_rules: Synthetic admin identity 'admin:aoy'; email pattern aoy+admin@example.test; no real PII (AP-Q7). Role=admin.

Synthetic customer C1 with synth email c1@example.test, synth phone +66-XX-XXX-XXX0 (non-routable test range), name and Thai-format address generated from a closed test gazetteer; never use real customer data (AP-Q7).
Second synthetic customer used for authz negative tests; same synthesis rules as C1 (AP-Q7).
Catalog SKU P1 seeded with stock_available=5, stock_reserved=0, stock_sold=0. No PII.
SKU P1 seeded with stock_available=2, stock_reserved=3 and 3 live reservations. No PII.
SKU P1 seeded with stock_available=1, stock_reserved=0. No PII.
Synthetic order O1 in status='delivered' for C1, one line for P1. Address and order_number synthesized; tracking_number from synth carrier ID space (AP-Q7).
Synthetic order O1 in status='paid' (not delivered) for C1 (AP-Q7).
Synthetic order O1 delivered with one pre-existing review row for the P1 line (AP-Q7).
Review row R1 with synth text in Thai; no incidental PII; tied to C1+O1+P1 (AP-Q7).
Synthetic review whose content is configured to trigger a specific moderation rule_id for tipping-off-copy tests (AP-Q7, AP-Q11).
Seeded audit row 'product.price_changed' with before={price:1290}, after={price:999}. No customer PII.
Synth corpus of mixed audit rows covering catalog/order/identity/payment/fulfillment events. Marker tokens injected for scrubbing assertions; never any real PII (AP-Q7).

Synth corpus exercising one instance of each enumerated state-changing event class across all epics (catalog.*, order.*, inventory.adjusted, review.created, review.hidden, identity.*, payment.*, fulfillment.*).
Synth corpus of customer-facing notifications: order-status updates, signup confirm, password reset, review-status. Synth recipients only (AP-Q7).

Marker-tokenized synthetic PII corpus driven through the system to produce realistic log volume. Markers are well-known sentinel strings ('SENTINEL_PWD', 'SENTINEL_TOKEN', etc.) so post-hoc log scans can deterministically count leaks. No real PII (AP-Q7).
